text: Spells answer each other on your island. A phoenix sets dry grass alight where it lands and hisses in water. A lantern at night burns the creatures of the dark, and a darkness lets them walk by day. Blasts blow out small fires, fan big ones and throw water out of a pond. Burnt ground grows back faster. Fire and ice creatures fight, holy light burns the undead, water on lava turns to stone and fire on ice melts it. Challenges play as before.
